auth.signInSubtitle: Use the account your support team set up for you.
auth.noAccount: No account yet? Your administrator creates accounts.
auth.forgotPassword: Forgot your password? Ask your administrator to reset it.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired, so you've been signed out to keep your account safe. Sign in again to carry on.
auth.staffAccount: This app is for customers. Technicians, managers and admins, please use the web portal.

password.forcedSubtitle: Your account was set up with a temporary password. Choose your own to continue.
password.tooLong: That password is too long. Use fewer characters.
password.mismatch: The two new passwords don't match.
password.sameAsCurrent: Choose a password different from the current one.

offline.title: Can't reach the help desk
offline.body: Check your connection and try again. You're still signed in.
offline.configBody: This build has no valid server address. Please contact your administrator.
offline.banner: You're offline. Showing what was last loaded; sending needs a connection.

errors.network: Can't reach the help desk. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeout: The help desk took too long to answer. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited_one: You're going a bit fast. Please try again in {{count}} second.
errors.rateLimited_other: You're going a bit fast. Please try again in {{count}} seconds.
errors.unavailable: The help desk is busy right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have access to that.
errors.notFound: We couldn't find that. It may have been removed.
errors.badCredentials: That email and password don't match. Please check and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.deactivated: This account has been turned off. Please contact your support team.
errors.passwordChangeRequired: Please choose a new password to continue.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.emptyBody: Raise a ticket, or start a chat — we'll track it here.

ticket.reopenPrompt: Not solved after all? Reopen the ticket and our support team will take it from here.
ticket.closedNote: This ticket is closed. Raise a new one if you need more help.
ticket.sendingHint: Sending — if our AI assistant is handling this ticket it will reply in a few seconds.
ticket.replyTooLong: Your reply is too long (at most {{max}} characters).

newTicket.title: Raise a ticket
newTicket.subtitle: We'll reply in the ticket thread and by email.
newTicket.subject: Subject
newTicket.descriptionPlaceholder: What happened, where in the product, and what you've tried so far.
newTicket.submittingHint: Our AI assistant reads every new ticket first, so this can take a few seconds.
newTicket.categoriesFailed: Categories couldn't be loaded. You can still send the ticket without one.
newTicket.timeout: The help desk took too long to answer. Your ticket may still have been created — check Tickets before sending it again.
newTicket.continueWithout: Open the ticket without these files

chat.title: Chat
chat.startSubtitle: Our support bot answers right away and brings in the support team if needed.
chat.issue: What do you need help with?
chat.issuePlaceholder: Describe the problem, or what you're trying to do
chat.issueRequired: Tell us what you need help with.
chat.startingHint: The support bot is reading your message — this takes a few seconds.
chat.startTimeout: The help desk took too long to answer, but your chat may have started. Check Your chats below before starting another.
chat.emptyBody: Start a chat for a quick answer from the support bot.
chat.tooLong: Your message is too long (at most {{max}} characters).
chat.solvedNeedsAnswer: Available once the support bot has answered.
chat.confirmText: We'll create a ticket for our support team with this whole conversation, so you won't need to repeat anything.
chat.subject: Ticket subject
chat.timeout: The help desk took too long to answer. Your message may have gone through — we've reloaded the chat, so check it before sending again.
chat.actionTimeout: The help desk took too long to answer. We've reloaded the chat to show where it stands.
chat.resolvedNote: This chat is resolved and closed. Start a new chat any time.
chat.escalatedNote: Escalated to our support team as ticket {{id}}. They'll reply in the ticket.

attachments.title: Attachments (optional)
attachments.rules: Up to {{max}} files, {{mb}} MB each: PNG, JPG, PDF, TXT or LOG.
attachments.full: That's the most files one message can carry ({{max}}).

reject.type: {{name}} can't be attached: only PNG, JPG, PDF, TXT and LOG files are allowed.
reject.count: {{name}} wasn't added: at most {{max}} files per message.

attachments.cameraDenied: Camera access is off for this app.
attachments.pickFailed: That file couldn't be read. Try choosing it again.
attachments.ticketUploadFailed: Ticket {{id}} was created, but the files didn't upload: {{reason}}
attachments.replyUploadFailed: Your reply was sent, but the files didn't upload: {{reason}}
attachments.uploadTimeout: The upload took too long. The files may have arrived — check the ticket before trying again.
attachments.fixAndRetry: Remove or replace the file it names, then retry.
attachments.noViewer: No app on this device can open {{name}}.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: This screen ran into a problem. Your tickets and chats are safe. Try again, or close and reopen the app.
